summary: Connect climate scenarios to borrower and portfolio credit decisions. Explore the five-day course and practical learning outcomes.
lede: Climate-risk assessment in bank credit connects physical and transition drivers to borrower repayment and portfolio risk. For credit analysts, portfolio managers and risk officers, it supports evaluating climate exposure in lending decisions by examining effects on cash flow, collateral and repayment capacity. Learners practise mapping scenario assumptions to credit sensitivities, considering PD, LGD and EAD, monitoring portfolio concentrations and documenting judgments without treating scenarios as precise forecasts.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for banking professionals who assess borrower repayment, review credit exposures or report portfolio risk and need to incorporate climate drivers into those responsibilities.
modules: Climate Drivers in Borrower Cash Flow
prerequisites: Working knowledge of bank lending, credit analysis or portfolio risk is expected. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel installed for spreadsheet-based scenario sensitivity exercises; no separate software account is required.
